# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The canonical repository instructions are in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Apply that contract to every suggestion and change, including SpecGov's product boundaries, deterministic/offline core, explicit-domain enforcement, safe opt-in semantic protocol, v1 clean break, documentation traceability, and required gates.

Do not introduce additional public CLI commands: the v1 CLI is limited to `init`, `check`, and `graph`.
